text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills slipped to 30.19 percent from 30.65 percent at the last sale on October 22, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 1.67 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.55 million UAH 4.65 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 16,727 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 3,800 were competitive and 12,927 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills edged up to 49.39 percent from 49.36 percent at the last sale on October 25, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 9.93 million UAH 21.83 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.97 million UAH 17.52 million UAH
The central bank sold 99,359 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 29,293 were competitive and 70,066 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 31.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 58.12 percent from 58.20 percent at the last sale on October 25, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 22.22 million UAH 32.81 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.49 million UAH 22.86 million UAH
The central bank sold 222,256 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 208,615 were competitive and 13,641 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 31.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged slipped to 60.94 percent from 61.04 percent at the last sale on October 25, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 2,773 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,058 were competitive and 1,715 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 31.
